name: Silk Magnet
source:
Defne solves problems before anyone asks. Merve can make an unbearable room livable. Su notices the pattern everyone else misses.

When precarious jobs funnel all three women into the same corporate hiring process, those strengths become measurable—and therefore useful to someone else. The company offers stability while quietly teaching them to classify one another. Their shared apartment becomes a workplace, an evidence room, and the last place where a decision might still belong to the people who must live with it.

Silk Magnet is a 13-chapter literary visual novel about friendship under economic pressure. Choices emerge through observing spaces, arranging objects, protecting or sharing information, restoring language, and deciding who may carry a piece of evidence. Consequences return through behaviour, access, and memory rather than a visible morality score.
